rules: CC-8: the v2 ticket format of tickets.json with c = "btc", k = "commit" | "reveal"; the field meanings are in src/contracts/http.ts

context = the relay's network, the route chain (btc), the raw tx (hex) and `prevouts`: what the relay's own chain read returns for each input outpoint ("<txid>:<vout>" → { value sats, script hex }); an outpoint absent from `prevouts` is one the read did not find
every valid raw is a genuine signed tx (txid t, sha256 r); the signatures are deterministic
each negative has one malformed ticket field (relay.send-ticket); each decode vector has exactly one defect in the signed tx or the chain read

valid.name: local commit: one lane UTXO, the reveal output and the change; f = the fee exactly
local reveal: spends the commit output by the script path, one postage output; f = the fee exactly
testnet commit: two lane UTXOs; f above the fee
testnet reveal; f above the fee
mainnet commit (the relay refuses it while mainnet job sends are locked: release.mainnet-locked)
local commit without change: the lane UTXO exactly covers the reveal output and the fee

decode.name: btc-commit-extra-input
decode.defect: the tx spends FUND1 and FUND2; the ticket declares FUND1 only

decode.name: btc-commit-missing-input
decode.defect: the tx spends FUND1; the ticket declares FUND1 and FUND2

decode.name: btc-commit-other-input
decode.defect: the tx spends FUND2; the ticket declares FUND1

decode.name: btc-commit-extra-output
decode.defect: a third output pays an attacker

decode.name: btc-commit-two-change-outputs
decode.defect: the change is split in two outputs, both to the lane

decode.name: btc-commit-change-foreign
decode.defect: the change pays another address

decode.name: btc-commit-value
decode.defect: the reveal output pays one sat more than the ticket value

decode.name: btc-commit-value-less
decode.defect: the reveal output pays one sat less than the ticket value

decode.name: btc-commit-to
decode.defect: the reveal output pays another taproot address

decode.name: btc-commit-fee
decode.defect: the change is one sat lower: fee = f + 1

decode.name: btc-commit-fee-no-change
decode.defect: no change output: everything above the reveal output is fee, more than f

decode.name: btc-commit-outputs-exceed-inputs
decode.defect: the chain says the input is worth less than the outputs: fee < 0

decode.name: btc-commit-input-not-lane
decode.defect: the input pays another address than a

decode.name: btc-commit-to-not-taproot
decode.defect: the ticket `to` and the output are a P2WPKH address, not a taproot one

decode.name: btc-commit-to-is-lane
decode.defect: the ticket `to` is the lane address itself

decode.name: btc-commit-duplicate-to
decode.defect: two outputs to `to`

decode.name: btc-commit-locktime
decode.defect: locktime 1

decode.name: btc-commit-unsigned
decode.defect: the inputs carry no signature

decode.name: btc-commit-tx-id
decode.defect: the ticket t is another tx's id (r still binds these bytes)

decode.name: btc-commit-trailing-byte
decode.defect: a genuine commit followed by one more byte

decode.name: btc-commit-empty-witness-marker
decode.defect: the segwit marker with an empty witness for the input: not the canonical serialization

decode.name: btc-commit-sighash-none
decode.defect: a commit input signed SIGHASH_NONE: anyone may re-spend the public signature with other outputs

decode.name: btc-commit-sighash-none-anyonecanpay
decode.defect: a commit input signed SIGHASH_NONE|ANYONECANPAY

decode.name: btc-commit-sighash-single
decode.defect: a commit input signed SIGHASH_SINGLE: only output 0 is signed, the change is free

decode.name: btc-commit-sighash-single-anyonecanpay
decode.defect: a commit input signed SIGHASH_SINGLE|ANYONECANPAY

decode.name: btc-commit-sighash-all-anyonecanpay
decode.defect: a commit input signed SIGHASH_ALL|ANYONECANPAY: further inputs may be added by anyone

decode.name: btc-commit-reveal-bytes
decode.defect: a genuine reveal tx under a commit ticket

decode.name: btc-commit-prevout-missing
decode.defect: the relay's chain read finds no such unspent output

decode.name: btc-commit-prevout-one-of-two-missing
decode.defect: the chain read finds FUND1 but not FUND2

decode.name: btc-reveal-body
decode.defect: one body byte changed: sha256(body) ≠ p

decode.name: btc-reveal-body-empty
decode.defect: an empty body

decode.name: btc-reveal-content-type-bare
decode.defect: content type text/plain (no charset)

decode.name: btc-reveal-content-type-html
decode.defect: content type text/html;charset=utf-8

decode.name: btc-reveal-content-type-case
decode.defect: content type text/plain;charset=UTF-8

decode.name: btc-reveal-no-content-type
decode.defect: no content-type tag

decode.name: btc-reveal-extra-tag
decode.defect: a metaprotocol tag besides the content type

decode.name: btc-reveal-cursed
decode.defect: a cursed envelope: the content-type tag is pushed as OP_1

decode.name: btc-reveal-parser-op0-mid-body
decode.defect: S1: body, OP_0, then more pushes: ord appends the attacker suffix, micro-ordinals stops at the OP_0

decode.name: btc-reveal-parser-hidden-first-envelope
decode.defect: S2: a first envelope opened by OP_PUSHDATA1 0x00 inside an unexecuted OP_0 OP_IF: ord numbers the attacker's text/html i0

decode.name: btc-reveal-parser-split-content-type
decode.defect: S3: the content-type tag pushed twice ("t" + the rest): micro-ordinals concatenates, ord keeps the first

decode.name: btc-reveal-body-two-pushes
decode.defect: the same body in two pushes (ord and micro-ordinals agree, the canonical script has one)

decode.name: btc-reveal-body-pushdata1
decode.defect: the body pushed with OP_PUSHDATA1 although it is under 76 bytes (non-minimal)

decode.name: btc-reveal-trailing-op
decode.defect: an OP_NOP after OP_ENDIF

decode.name: btc-reveal-leaf-without-checksig
decode.defect: the key push without OP_CHECKSIG

decode.name: btc-reveal-foreign-key
decode.defect: the leaf names (and is signed by) another key: the destination is not that key's p2tr

decode.name: btc-reveal-internal-key
decode.defect: a single-leaf control block over the lane key instead of NUMS

decode.name: btc-reveal-annex
decode.defect: a fourth witness item starting with 0x50 (an annex)

decode.name: btc-reveal-two-inscriptions
decode.defect: two inscriptions in one envelope script

decode.name: btc-reveal-other-outpoint
decode.defect: the reveal spends another commit's output; the ticket declares commit1:0

decode.name: btc-reveal-extra-input
decode.defect: a second input (a lane UTXO) besides the commit output

decode.name: btc-reveal-extra-output
decode.defect: a second output

decode.name: btc-reveal-destination
decode.defect: the inscription output pays another address

decode.name: btc-reveal-value
decode.defect: the inscription output pays one sat more

decode.name: btc-reveal-fee
decode.defect: f is one sat below the fee

decode.name: btc-reveal-outputs-exceed-input
decode.defect: the chain says the commit output is worth less than the postage

decode.name: btc-reveal-p2wpkh-spend
decode.defect: a plain P2WPKH spend of the declared outpoint: no inscription envelope

decode.name: btc-reveal-locktime
decode.defect: locktime 1

decode.name: btc-reveal-unsigned
decode.defect: the input carries no witness

decode.name: btc-reveal-commit-bytes
decode.defect: a genuine commit tx under a reveal ticket

decode.name: btc-reveal-kind-p

decode.name: btc-reveal-prevout-missing
